name: imgen

scripts.build: bun build --compile --outfile dist/imgen src/index.tsx && codesign --force --sign - dist/imgen && codesign --verify --strict dist/imgen
scripts.dist: bun run build && cd dist && tar -czf imgen-darwin-arm64.tar.gz imgen && shasum -a 256 imgen-darwin-arm64.tar.gz

description: A terminal browser and generator for the images the Codex CLI makes
